# Throwaway fixture "laws"

These are NOT spec surface. They exist so the binder's REFUSALS can be exercised, which the
real corpus cannot do — every unit there is a well-formed stub, and that is the point.

`301` §0's `law-spec-touch-frontier-human-only` binds `minispec/`. These files are deliberately
outside it, in ordinary builder test-fixture space, and nothing reads them but
`tests/binder_refuses.rs`. They are not lake targets and no law is stated over them.
